name: semantic_recall
description: ⚡ PRIORITY TOOL - CHECK FIRST! CONCEPTUAL/MEANING search using AI embeddings. USE THIS BEFORE action tools when user asks questions about things they told you, preferences, or past setups. Matches by meaning, not exact words. Examples: 'what did you say about X', 'how is Y configured', 'where is Z running'. ALWAYS try this first before execute_bash, query_service_logs, or api_call. For specific entity names/keywords, use search_memory (faster).

query.description: Natural language search query - can be a question or topic

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return
